# eci_pricing (Data Source)

Pricing

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "eci_pricing" "vm_pricing" {
  name         = "M-8"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

data "eci_pricing" "storage_pricing" {
  name         = "Block Storage"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}

data "eci_pricing" "ip_pricing" {
  name         = "Public IP"
  pricing_type = "ondemand"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) human-readable name of the pricing
- `pricing_type` (String) type of pricing (ondemand, reserved)

### Optional

- `resource_kind` (String) kind of resource this pricing applies to (vm_allocation, block_storage, public_ip, etc.)

### Read-Only

- `activated` (Boolean) whether this pricing is activated
- `amount` (Attributes Map) price per hour by currency (krw, usd); usd is in cents (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--amount))
- `created` (String) time when the pricing is created
- `end` (String) end time of this pricing validity period
- `id` (String) unique identifier of the pricing
- `listed_price_per_hour` (String) listed price per hour
- `modified` (String) last time when the pricing is modified
- `organization_id` (String) id of organization that the pricing belongs to (null for global pricing)
- `price_per_hour` (String) actual price per hour
- `quota` (Number) quota limit for this pricing (null for unlimited)
- `resource_id` (String) id of specific resource instance (null for generic pricing)
- `start` (String) start time of this pricing validity period
- `tags` (Map of String) user-defined metadata of key-value pairs
- `zone_id` (String) id of zone that the pricing belongs to

<a id="nestedatt--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `amount`

Read-Only:

- `listed_per_hour` (String) listed price per hour
- `per_hour` (String) actual price per hour
